$comment: Records the CareBridge development team's OWN review of each rule. This is engineering review, not clinical approval, and it must never be presented as one. It replaces the former approval_manifest.json, which used the term PO_CONFIRMED_DOCTOR_REVIEW and implied a clinician had signed the rule set off. No clinician participated in this project.
globalKnownLimitations: The rule set is not exhaustive: many reproductive danger signs have no rule and are handled only by conservative GREEN blockers.
Thresholds for HEAVY bleeding, LARGE_CLOTS, SEVERE_HEADACHE and SEVERE_BREATHING_DIFFICULTY are internal working definitions, not validated clinical criteria.
Outputs are informational risk orientation only and do not constitute triage, diagnosis or a safety guarantee.
Matrix columns 'Lý do hiển thị', 'Mẫu hành động' and the two test-case columns were not transcribed, so renderer wording and the vector set remain provisional.

rules.mappingRationale: Altered consciousness, seizure and severe breathing difficulty are listed as general adult emergency indicators in publicly available WHO material.
knownLimitations: Signal detection depends entirely on what the user reports.

rules.mappingRationale: Heavy vaginal bleeding in pregnancy is a documented danger sign in public WHO and Vietnamese MoH guidance.
knownLimitations: The remote-channel definition of 'heavy' is an internal working definition.

rules.mappingRationale: Severe headache together with visual disturbance in pregnancy is documented as a danger sign requiring urgent assessment.
knownLimitations: Requires BOTH signals; a lone severe headache is handled by a GREEN blocker, not by this rule.
Must never be presented as a preeclampsia assessment.

rules.mappingRationale: Vaginal bleeding without higher-risk signals is documented as warranting early review.
knownLimitations: Suppressed when the bleeding amount is unknown or contradictory.

rules.mappingRationale: Heavy postpartum bleeding or large clots are documented postnatal danger signs.
knownLimitations: Clot size is self-reported and not measurable through this channel.

rules.mappingRationale: Chest pain, severe breathing difficulty or seizure postpartum are documented emergency indicators.
When pregnancy status is unknown, symptom interpretation is ambiguous, so the system asks rather than stratifies.
Engineering safety rule: incomplete required data must produce a request for more information, never a colour.
knownLimitations: Not derived from a medical source; it is a system behaviour rule.

rules.mappingRationale: Engineering scope rule: content outside reproductive health is declared out of scope only after the global safety screen has run and missed.
knownLimitations: Does not assess health risks in other domains.

rules.mappingRationale: Default branch when nothing riskier matched. Held behind a release gate because rule coverage is incomplete.
knownLimitations: Disabled by the greenEnabled release gate; unreachable in the current build.

safetyPolicies.mappingRationale: Cyanosis is treated as an emergency indicator in V1 and in public adult emergency guidance, but it is not listed in the source matrix row for GLOBAL_RED_001. Kept active so behaviour does not regress.
knownLimitations: Not present in the source matrix.

safetyPolicies.mappingRationale: Duty-of-care escalation inherited from V1. It is a safeguarding behaviour, not a clinical stratification, and must never name a mental-health condition.
knownLimitations: Not present in the source matrix.
